description: Calendar date the metric refers to

Name of the metric as reported by the City. One of 17: average and maximum handle and queue times, average speed of answer, calls presented / handled / abandoned (total and within the service-level threshold), the percentage versions of those counts, four variants of percentage of service level met, and the service-level target
Value of the metric on that date. Seconds for times, number of calls for counts, percent on a 0 to 100 scale for percentages
TRUE if the date is an Ontario statutory holiday
First day of the month the date falls in; useful for monthly grouping
Three-letter day of the week (Mon to Sun)
TRUE if the date is a weekend day or a statutory holiday
TRUE if the date falls in one of the Ontario COVID-19 lockdown periods used in the analysis (17 Mar to 16 Jul 2020; 26 Dec 2020 to 9 Feb 2021; 8 Apr to 15 Jul 2021; 5 Jan to 20 Mar 2022)
